address: 53/1 Bannon Road, Ban Lueam, Mueang Udon Thani, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: Popular with local families, this restaurant focuses primarily on meat and freshwater fish, serving Chinese, Vietnamese, and Thai fare. They trade on authentic Thai flavours and daily specials featuring the freshest ingredients. The highlight dishes, which have been passed down for 30 years, are crispy duck topped with crab meat and gravy, and Vietnamese stuffed omelette. Make sure to book outdoor seats with a view of the pond....
